$comment: ripwire (https://github.com/redhat-et/ripwire) as a persistent index server. Parse once, many warm queries (~0.1s) - the CLI form re-reads the TMPDIR cache per invocation instead. Started through a shim so a missing binary yields one actionable line rather than 'command not found' on every session start. Which agent may call which verb is decided in each agent's tools: list, not here.
